systems.name: 1.1 Player Controller
systems.notes: Tight, responsive PS1‑style 3D platformer controls. Must support keyboard and gamepad. Acceleration, deceleration, jump arc, and coyote time.

tasks.notes: Analog stick + d‑pad simulation. No ice physics.

tasks.text: Jump with variable height (hold to jump higher)

tasks.notes: Nice to have but not essential for core feel.

systems.name: 1.2 Camera System
systems.notes: Third‑person follow camera with manual rotation. Must avoid clipping through geometry. PS1‑style auto‑adjust when near walls.
tasks: Smooth look‑ahead based on player velocity

systems.name: 1.3 Basic Physics & Collision
systems.notes: Already have a physics module. Needs refinement for platforming: stepped collisions, slopes, moving platforms.
tasks: AABB / sphere vs triangle mesh collision
